notes.group:rear-side-lights-turn-on-when-dayt: ExteriorLights.cs MQB_09_RearLightsWhenDayLights (lines 11-223). Enable: first lamp slot C..H whose function is 00 or 0x14 gets FunctionX=0x14 (DRL) and the pair Dimmwert=70 (direction bit kept). Encoded: ONLY the vendor's slot-C branch, guarded with when.bytes: enable requires FunctionC (byte7 bits0-6) in {00,0x14} -> FunctionC=0x14, DimmwertCD (byte9 bits0-6)=70; disable when FunctionC==0x14: FunctionC=0 and DimmwertCD=0 only if FunctionD (byte8 bits0-6)==00, else DimmwertCD kept; disable when FunctionC==00 is a no-op. Any other FunctionC (slot C used for another lamp function) refuses instead of overwriting it (vendor would move on to D..H). Owner Kushaq 2Q0937089D live 0567=2D0A002908097F00.. (byte7=00). 0568 not read live yet.
notes.group:corner-function-activation: ExteriorLights.cs MQB_09_CornerActivation_NOT_LED. Step1 055C FunctionB (byte5 bits0-6)=0x16 / 00; step2 055D FunctionB=0x17 / 00. Step3 0D1D (Unit09 alt): vendor writes only on Enable (Disable returns data unchanged), so it has one choice and is restored from its backup on disable. New BCM final bytes: [0]=31 (SwitchBit 0.0 then array[0]=31), byte1 bits0-2=010, [2]=0,[3]=80,[5]=128,[6]=80,[7]=120,[8]=100,[9]=200,[10]=190,[11]=160. Old BCM: bit0.1=1, byte2 bits3-5=010, [3]=0,[4]=80,[6]=127,[7]=80,[8]=120,[9]=100,[10]=200,[11]=190,[12]=160. Owner Kushaq live 055C=0A380022 1216 64.. (FunctionB already 0x16) and 055D=..1317.. so the fog channels are 055C/055D on the A0 BCM.

notes.el-fogs-off-with-high-beam: 055C/055D slot G = 0x0D / 0x0E (high beam L/R, as vendor FogLights_ActivateWithHighBeam) with byte15 = 0x80 (dim GH 0, minimise): GH has top priority, so the fog lamp goes dark while high beam is on. Enable needs G = 00 and H = 00 (or already this state); refuses when G holds high beam at 0x64 (Fog Lights with High Beam) or H is set (flash-to-pass shares dim GH). Off: G = 00, byte15 = 00 (Kushaq stock). Medium (t6forum behaviour). Note: the vendor flash-to-pass / with-high-beam steps are unguarded; enabling one of them after this one rewrites byte15 = 0x64.
